history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A black automatic scooter is parked on a herringbone brick pathway in front of a house at night. The scooter is the primary subject, angled slightly towards the viewer, with its headlights off. The pathway is illuminated by overhead streetlights casting long shadows. To the left of the scooter, a metal gate is visible, leading to a darker area. The house in the background has white walls and a wooden-paneled overhang. Various plants and potted greenery are scattered around the property, some near the house entrance and others along the pathway. A clothesline with laundry is hanging near the house entrance. The overall lighting is dim and atmospheric, with a cool, slightly bluish cast from the artificial lights. The scene evokes a quiet, residential nighttime ambiance. The color palette is dominated by dark tones of black, gray, and brown, with muted greens from the foliage and the white of the house providing contrast. The style is realistic.
